'''Aviso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Aviso traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] to collect the [[XNA-580]]&mdash;a device developed by the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Raahan Ma'ase]] that could manipulate the brainwaves of most [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;on behalf of the Confederate leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].
